The '''Gravaal mountain range''' were a mountain range on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. They passed close to the [[Suporro Sea]] near the city of [[Cormond]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
